MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 60

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

13. Solve for x: x + 9 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 14
   D. 6

14. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 11

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

18. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 6
   C. 12.5
   D. 5

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

21. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

23. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

24. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
